Job Purpose :
To provide actionable market, customer, and competitor insights that support strategic decision-making, enhance commercial performance, and strengthen the company's competitive positioning.

Main Responsibility :

• Analyze market trends, industry developments, and macroeconomic factors that may impact business performance and identify their implications for the organization.
• Conduct field surveys and market exploration to gather insights from relevant stakeholders, including RO Owners, customers, sales teams, and other business partners, to understand market conditions, customer needs, and business challenges.
• Monitor and analyze competitor strategies, products, offerings, campaigns, pricing, and go-to-market approaches, including benchmarking against internal products and market competitors.
• Develop a strong understanding of internal and competitor products, including product features, value propositions, pricing, and market positioning, to support comparative analysis and identify opportunities for improvement.
• Identify emerging market needs, customer behavior, industry trends, and potential business opportunities through both field research and analysis of internal and external data.
• Collect, validate, and analyze data from internal and external sources, combining quantitative data with field insights to generate meaningful business insights and actionable recommendations.
• Translate survey findings and market analysis into structured strategic reports and business recommendations for management, particularly for Regional General Managers (RGH) and Head of Sales (HOS).
• Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to support annual business planning, forecasting, performance reviews, and strategic decision-making.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders to validate findings, understand market dynamics, and ensure that recommendations are relevant to business needs.

Employment Status:

Permanent (P)

su-tpia-1369413166.d:
Chandra Asri Group is a leading chemical and infrastructure solutions company in Indonesia with a track record of over 31 years in the petrochemical industry. The company employs over 2,000 dedicated staff, incorporates state-of-the art technologies and supporting facilities located strategically in the country’s industrial hub, Cilegon and Serang. As a Growth Partner, Chandra Asri is committed on creating high-value jobs, expanding the domestic petrochemical value chain, and serving the needs of the vibrant and growing Indonesian market. Chandra Asri is currently expanding its portfolio in the energy sector and incorporating its asset as well as operational infrastructure to supports the expansion plan of the second world-scale integrated petrochemical complex in Indonesia, CAP2.
Job Descriptions

• Carry out all routine/non-routine maintenance work related to electrical Equipment, includes regular maintenance patrol, evaluate and take necessary action to fix any electrical problem or follow up problem found in the previous shift.
• Implement the electrical field activity to follow the work instruction and procedure correctly to increase productivity and keep production process smoothly. Check and identify electrical equipment problems to specify root cause to achieve equipment rectification correctly.
• Implement safe working practices and good housekeeping at the activity of Electrical Maintenance team in accordance the safety and health, environment and Quality Management systems.
• Conduct proper waste handling as an impact of those above activities to comply with relevant environmental law and regulation.
• Directly responsible with a shift contractor who assist him to perform his shift job.
• Perform clear written and oral communication among operation, other shift team and contractor during performing his job. Record and report immediately any abnormality to the related section/Department during his duty.

Qualifications

• Min Diploma 3 in Electrical Engineering
• Min 3 years of working experience in the same field
• Able to speak and write in English well
• Familiar with MS Office applications
• Proactive, self-motivated and team work oriented
• Willing to be placed in site office, Anyer - Banten

This position will be placed at site office Cilegon.
Important Notes
Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.capcx.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.
